title: Decision Choices Ledger
description: Per-change ledger of implementation-time decisions made where the spec was silent, produced by an independent read-only auditor pass. choices.json is the source of truth; choices.md is rendered from it ranked least-confident first.

header.description: Codeviz artifact header (event artifact form). Field set matches skills/prioritize-proposals/scripts/artifact_header.py; migrate to skills/shared/artifact_header.py when it ships.

change_id.description: OpenSpec change id this ledger audits, or 'range:<base>..<head>' for standalone commit-range audits.

auditor.description: Provenance of the independent auditor dispatch.

stable_id.description: Content-derived hash of (normalized choice headline + primary file set + gap text). Idempotent across re-audits of an unchanged decision.

choice.description: Headline of the decision the implementation embodies.

scenario.description: Concrete scenario walked end to end in plain language: triggering event, behavior as built, and the alternative behavior. Must stand alone without the diff or transcript.

gap.description: What the spec, design, or tasks left unspecified that forced this choice.

reach.description: What this choice constrains or enables for future work.

confidence.description: Auditor's confidence in its own verdict. Rendering orders ascending: low, medium, high.

self_reported.description: True when a matching implementer-reported decision exists in session-log/handoffs; false when the auditor found a decision the implementer never reported.

session_log_ref.description: Cross-reference to the matching self-reported decision: '<change-id>#D<n>' or phase-qualified '<change-id>#<phase-slug>/D<n>'. Present iff self_reported is true.
